en.headline: Wine and Dine Festival adds later nights and more stalls
en.dek: The Tourism Board said the Central Harbourfront event from 29 October to 1 November expects about 168,000 visitors and will open until 1am on two nights.
body: The Hong Kong Tourism Board said this year's Wine and Dine Festival will run from 29 October to 1 November and expand from the Central Harbourfront Event Space into Tamar Park. The board expects about 168,000 visitors, compared with about 160,000 last year.

The event, themed Taste the World's Best, will have more than 340 stalls, about 10 per cent more than last year, with food and wine from about 30 countries and regions. Pavilions from Australia, Canada and South Korea will appear for the first time, the board said.

Opening hours are 7.30pm to midnight on the first day, 1pm to 1am on 30 and 31 October, and 1pm to midnight on 1 November. A tasting pass is priced at 258 dollars and a grand wine pass at 558 dollars. The board said tickets will be sold at the door and that online booking opens next Monday.

A Hong Kong Gourmet Month is planned for November, with festival ticket-stub holders offered deals at selected restaurants and shops. Board chairman Peter Lam said the board hoped the programme would encourage longer stays and more business for the trade.

zh.headline: 美酒佳餚巡禮增設深夜時段 攤位多一成
zh.dek: 旅發局稱，巡禮10月29日至11月1日於中環海濱舉行，並擴至添馬公園，預計約16.8萬人次到場。
body: 香港旅遊發展局表示，本年度香港美酒佳餚巡禮將於10月29日至11月1日舉行，場地由中環海濱活動空間擴展至添馬公園。旅發局預計約16.8萬人次到場，去年約16萬人次。
活動主題為「品嚐世界最佳」，設逾340個攤位，較去年多約一成，有來自約30個國家及地區的美食和美酒。澳洲、加拿大及南韓展館將首次登場。
首日由晚上7時30分開放至午夜；10月30日及31日由下午1時開放至凌晨1時；11月1日由下午1時開放至午夜。品酒證售258元，美酒尊享證售558元。旅發局稱現場可購票，網上預訂下周一開始。
11月將另設「香港美食月」，持巡禮票根的人士可在指定餐廳及商戶獲得優惠。旅發局主席林建岳表示，希望活動鼓勵旅客留港更久，為業界帶來更多生意。
